title: Pure and physics-guided deep learning approaches for spatio-temporal groundwater level prediction
abstract: arXiv:2603.25779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Groundwater represents a key element of the water cycle, yet it exhibits complex and context-dependent relationships that make its modeling challenging. Theory-based models have been the cornerstone of scientific understanding. However, their computational cost, simplifying assumptions, and calibration requirements limit their use. In recent years, data-driven models have emerged as powerful alternatives. In particular, deep learning has proven to be a promising approach for its design flexibility and ability to learn complex relationships directly from the data without requiring extensive domain information. We proposed an attention-based pure deep learning model, named STAINet, to predict weekly groundwater levels in Piedmont (Italy), leveraging both irregular groundwater time series and weather image sequences. To enhance the model's trustworthiness and generalization ability, we merged the theory and data-driven approaches

translated_title: 纯深度学习与物理引导深度学习方法用于时空地下水位预测
translated_abstract: 地下水是水循环的关键要素，但其表现出复杂且依赖于具体情境的关系，这使得其建模具有挑战性。基于理论的模型一直是科学理解的基石，然而其计算成本、简化假设和参数校准要求限制了它们的应用。近年来，数据驱动模型已成为强大的替代方案。特别是深度学习凭借其设计灵活性以及无需大量领域知识即可直接从数据中学习复杂关系的能力，已被证明是一种有前景的方法。我们提出了一种基于注意力机制的纯深度学习模型，名为STAINet，利用不规则地下水时间序列和天气图像序列来预测意大利皮埃蒙特地区的周地下水位。为了增强模型的可信度和泛化能力，我们将理论与数据驱动方法相结合。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于注意力机制的纯深度学习模型STAINet，并结合物理引导方法，利用不规则地下水时间序列和天气图像序列预测意大利皮埃蒙特地区的周地下水位，同时提升了模型的可信度与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study proposes STAINet, an attention-based pure deep learning model combined with physics-guided approaches, which leverages irregular groundwater time series and weather image sequences to predict weekly groundwater levels in Piedmont, Italy, while enhancing model trustworthiness and generalization ability.
